verdict.rationale: impots.gouv.fr is a government tax-administration portal for filing, paying, and consulting tax records. It is not a platform where users write automations, so versioning, reviewing, and rolling back user automations is a category error for this product. The only automation-adjacent item is 'prélèvement automatique' (automatic direct debit of the CFE business tax), a payment option rather than a user-authored automation, so it does not make the axis applicable.
